project_type: FastAPI backend + Next.js 14 App Router frontend, Python 3.11 + TypeScript
build_system: uvicorn for backend server, npm/next for frontend, no build step required for Python
test_framework: None found in project — verification uses health endpoints and manual testing
build_command: Backend: cd try12/backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload (port 8000); Frontend: cd try12/frontend && npm run dev (port 3000)
test_command: No automated tests found. Verify via: curl http://localhost:8000/health (backend) and browser at http://localhost:3000 (frontend)
verification_instructions: Start backend server, check /health endpoint for feed_connected=true. Start frontend, check StatusBar shows 'Live' indicator. Navigate to new /regime page and verify data loads.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None — no generated files to commit
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Backend must run on port 8000, frontend on port 3000. Redis must be running on localhost:6379. PostgreSQL must be available at DATABASE_URL from .env. Do not restart servers during development — hot reload is active.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code patterns. Backend uses FastAPI with async/await. Frontend uses Next.js 14 App Router, Tanstack Query for data fetching, Zustand for global state. Components use inline styles with CSS custom properties (var(--green), var(--red), var(--text-2), var(--surface-2), var(--border), var(--accent), var(--text-3)). Use cn() utility from @/lib/utils for className merging.
key_patterns: Backend routes return JSON, use Depends(get_db) for DB access, use redis_cache singleton for Redis. Frontend components are client components ('use client'), use useQuery for GET requests with 5-30s refetchInterval, use inline styles with CSS vars, follow existing StatusBar and NavBar patterns for styling. API calls go through @/lib/api.ts wrapper. Types defined in @/types/market.ts.
directory_structure: Root: c:\Users\rushi\Downloads\try12fin. Backend: try12/backend/app with services/, api/routes/, db/models/. Frontend: try12/frontend with app/ (Next.js App Router pages), components/ (React components), lib/ (utilities and API client). Redis keys: ltp:{token}, tick:{token}, regime:{underlying}:current, regime:{underlying}:history. DB tables: regime_states (history), regime_performance (stats), regime_config (thresholds).
